The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

V. Parthiban, J.:— Learned counsel for the appellant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this second appeal. He has also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. Permission is granted. Accordingly, the Second Appeal is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is dismissed.
